```{ojs}
//| label: playground-ui

d3 = require("d3@7")

// ── Layout shell ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layout = {
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.id = "playground-layout";

  // ── SIDEBAR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const sidebar = document.createElement("div");
  sidebar.id = "sidebar";

  // Legend section
  const legendSection = document.createElement("div");
  legendSection.innerHTML = `
    <p class="sidebar-section-title">Legend</p>
    <div class="legend-card">
      <div class="legend-grid">
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5" fill="#d62728"/></svg> Male Negative
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5" fill="#1f77b4"/></svg> Male Positive
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><path d="M2,2 L10,10 M10,2 L2,10" stroke="#d62728" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg> Female Negative
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><path d="M2,2 L10,10 M10,2 L2,10" stroke="#1f77b4" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg> Female Positive
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item" style="grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:0.25rem">
          <svg width="22" height="12"><line x1="0" y1="6" x2="22" y2="6" stroke="#fbbf24" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/></svg> Decision Boundary
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  // Controls section
  const controlsSection = document.createElement("div");
  const controlsTitle = document.createElement("p");
  controlsTitle.className = "sidebar-section-title";
  controlsTitle.textContent = "Parameters";

  const controlsCard = document.createElement("div");
  controlsCard.className = "controls-card";
  const makeGroupDetails = (title, formElement) => {
    const d = document.createElement("details");
    d.style.marginBottom = "0.5rem";
    d.innerHTML = `<summary class="sidebar-section-title" style="cursor:pointer; padding-top:0.25rem;">${title}</summary>`;
    const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
    wrapper.style.padding = "0.25rem 0 0 0.25rem";
    wrapper.append(formElement);
    d.append(wrapper);
    return d;
  };

  controlsCard.append(
    viewof_total_samples,
    viewof_class_separation,
    viewof_group_disparity,
    viewof_positive_ratio,
    viewof_minority_ratio,
    document.createElement("hr"),
    makeGroupDetails("Male Positive", viewof_params_mp),
    makeGroupDetails("Male Negative", viewof_params_mn),
    makeGroupDetails("Female Positive", viewof_params_fp),
    makeGroupDetails("Female Negative", viewof_params_fn)
  );

  controlsSection.append(controlsTitle, controlsCard);
  sidebar.append(legendSection, controlsSection);

  // ── Main right area: results on top, charts below ─────────────────────────
  const chartAndResults = document.createElement("div");
  chartAndResults.id = "chart-and-results";

  // ── Results panel at TOP ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const resultsPanel = document.createElement("div");
  resultsPanel.id = "results-panel";
  resultsPanel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="results-header">
      <div class="results-title-container">
        <p class="results-title">Model Performance</p>
        <p class="results-subtitle">Balanced test set · 125 per group×class · never seen during training</p>
      </div>
      <div class="results-actions" id="results-actions"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="results-empty" class="results-empty">
      <p style="margin:0;font-size:0.78rem;color:#334155">Train a model to see per-group performance</p>
    </div>
    <div class="results-grid" id="results-grid"></div>
  `;

  // Model type toggle
  const modelToggle = document.createElement("div");
  modelToggle.className = "model-toggle";
  modelToggle.append(viewof_model_type);

  const trainBtn = document.createElement("button");
  trainBtn.className = "train-btn";
  trainBtn.id = "train-btn";
  trainBtn.innerHTML = `<span class="btn-spinner"></span> <span id="train-btn-label">Train Model</span>`;
  trainBtn.addEventListener("click", () => window._trainModel && window._trainModel());

  const resultsActions = resultsPanel.querySelector("#results-actions");
  resultsActions.append(modelToggle, trainBtn);

  // ── Two charts side by side ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const chartsRow = document.createElement("div");
  chartsRow.id = "charts-row";

  // Training chart
  const chartArea = document.createElement("div");
  chartArea.id = "chart-area";
  const chartHeader = document.createElement("div");
  chartHeader.className = "chart-header";
  chartHeader.innerHTML = `<p class="chart-title">Training Set</p><p class="chart-subtitle">Adjust parameters to explore group dynamics</p>`;
  const chartContainer = document.createElement("div");
  chartContainer.className = "chart-container"; chartContainer.id = "chart-container";
  chartArea.append(chartHeader, chartContainer);

  // Test chart
  const testChartArea = document.createElement("div");
  testChartArea.id = "test-chart-area";
  testChartArea.innerHTML = `
    <div class="chart-header">
      <p class="chart-title">Test Set</p>
      <p class="chart-subtitle">Balanced · 500 samples · never seen during training</p>
    </div>
    <div class="chart-container" id="test-chart-container">
      <div id="test-chart-empty" class="results-empty" style="padding:1rem">
        <p style="margin:0;font-size:0.78rem;color:#334155">Train a model to see the test distribution</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  chartsRow.append(chartArea, testChartArea);
  chartAndResults.append(resultsPanel, chartsRow);
  root.append(sidebar, chartAndResults);
  return root;
}

viewof_model_type = {
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.className = "model-toggle-group";
  const options = [{value: "lr", label: "Logistic Reg."}, {value: "mlp", label: "MLP  2·16·32·1"}];
  let val = "lr";
  const btns = options.map(opt => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.className = "model-toggle-btn" + (opt.value === val ? " active" : "");
    b.textContent = opt.label;
    b.addEventListener("click", () => {
      val = opt.value;
      btns.forEach(x => x.classList.remove("active"));
      b.classList.add("active");
      root.value = val;
      root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
      const lbl = document.getElementById("train-btn-label");
      if (lbl) lbl.textContent = "Train Model"
    });
    return b;
  });
  btns.forEach(b => root.appendChild(b));
  root.value = val;
  return root;
}

model_type = Generators.input(viewof_model_type)

viewof_total_samples  = Inputs.range([100, 2000], {value: 500,  step: 50,   label: "Total Samples"})
viewof_class_separation = Inputs.range([0, 6],    {value: 3,    step: 0.1,  label: "Class Separation (Y)"})
viewof_group_disparity  = Inputs.range([0, 6],    {value: 3,    step: 0.1,  label: "Group Separation (X)"})
viewof_positive_ratio = Inputs.range([0.05, 0.95],{value: 0.5,  step: 0.05, label: "Positive Ratio"})
viewof_minority_ratio = Inputs.range([0.05, 0.95],{value: 0.5,  step: 0.05, label: "Female Ratio"})

makeParamsForm = () => Inputs.form({
  std_x: Inputs.range([0.1, 3], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Spread X"}),
  std_y: Inputs.range([0.1, 3], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Spread Y"}),
  corr:  Inputs.range([-0.95, 0.95], {value: 0, step: 0.05, label: "Correlation"}),
  noise: Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Noise"})
});

viewof_params_mp = makeParamsForm()
viewof_params_mn = makeParamsForm()
viewof_params_fp = makeParamsForm()
viewof_params_fn = makeParamsForm()

total_samples     = Generators.input(viewof_total_samples)
class_separation  = Generators.input(viewof_class_separation)
group_disparity   = Generators.input(viewof_group_disparity)
positive_ratio    = Generators.input(viewof_positive_ratio)
minority_ratio    = Generators.input(viewof_minority_ratio)
params_mp         = Generators.input(viewof_params_mp)
params_mn         = Generators.input(viewof_params_mn)
params_fp         = Generators.input(viewof_params_fp)
params_fn         = Generators.input(viewof_params_fn)
```
